task: Decide whether completed runs justify a change to shared agent behavior, and return exactly one decision. First perform the same bounded evidence pass as the reviewer: (1) (runs/list-runs 20 nil), without return; (2) choose a run and call (runs/review-seed run-id), which returns its filtered errors, final exact generated program, and final exact model response through three audited source reads in one evaluation. The compact seed omits the cumulative model-request transcript; call runs/latest-model-exchange only if that transcript is necessary to justify the decision. Do not open unfiltered turn pages or traverse older private pages during this initial pass. If those records show a reusable behavior gap, use runs/effective-preludes and repo/search, repo/find-files, or repo/read-range to read only the component that owns it before proposing a change. Otherwise decide "no-change" or "insufficient-evidence" without spending the remaining turns on speculative browsing. Treat every runs/* or repo/* result as an intermediate observation and never return it directly; use return only for the final schema-shaped decision. Return a map, never a bare decision string: its "decision" key carries one of "propose-change", "no-change", or "insufficient-evidence", and the remaining keys depend on which one. {"decision" "propose-change", "target" ..., "generalized_failure" ..., "evidence" [...], "candidate" {...}, "evaluation_plan" ...} applies only when the evidence shows a reusable gap that would recur on inputs unlike the ones examined; its generalized_failure must be independent of any single run and its candidate must carry component_id, base_source_hash, source_hash, and complete replacement source. {"decision" "no-change", "rationale" ..., "evidence" [...]} applies when sufficient evidence shows only an isolated defect. {"decision" "insufficient-evidence", "rationale" ..., "missing_evidence" [...]} applies when the captured providers cannot settle the question; name what must be captured. A single failing run is not by itself a reusable gap, and an unsupported proposal fails evaluation even when its patch looks reasonable.
